mapper.select: SELECT ap.* FROM activity_participant ap INNER JOIN activity a ON ap.activity_id = a.id WHERE ap.participant_id = #{participantId} ORDER BY CASE a.status WHEN 'READY' THEN 1 WHEN 'CLOSED' THEN 2 WHEN 'OVER' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, a.start_time DESC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM activity_participant WHERE activity_id = #{activityId} AND participant_id = #{participantId}
